Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

measuringreligiouschange 1.0.2 (2026-11-13)

BREAKING CHANGES

  • create_projection_object() and Projection_object now take a single migration flag instead of separate emigration and immigration flags. Only emigration was ever read internally, so the two always acted as one switch.
  • light_migration and light_switching now default to TRUE everywhere, including test_object_generator(). This matches the existing defaults of create_projection_object() and base_object_generator(). Migration and switching output is therefore stored in abbreviated form unless light_migration = FALSE / light_switching = FALSE is set explicitly.
  • base_object_generator() and create_projection_object() now default to steps = 10 instead of steps = 11, so default projections end in 2070 instead of 2075. Set steps = 11 explicitly to reproduce earlier results.

BUG FIXES

  • Fixed project() failing with no_diff = TRUE because ASFR output lacked religion column names.
  • The Total column of the ASFR output now reports the realised rate (births / exposure) instead of the input ASFR. Under combined fertility factorization the two differ, so Total previously did not match the saved births.
  • Realised ASFRs (Total and all religion columns of the "total" structure) are now 0 where exposure is 0, instead of the unweighted mean of the structure rates. *_post_switch columns keep the mean of the applied rates, and religion columns of individual structures still report the applied rate. ASFR output again matches the May 2026 projection exactly.
  • Fixed R CMD check “no visible binding for global variable” notes: .data is now imported from ggplot2, plotting code uses .data$ for column names in aes(), and fold_asfr uses data.table::set() instead of := for Mother_age_group.

DOCUMENTATION

  • Documented the ASFR output convention for previous_asfr: Total is the realised rate (births / exposure), religion columns of individual structures hold the applied rates, and realised rates are 0 where exposure is 0.
  • Documented that combined_fertility_factorization defaults to TRUE (field docs and the inner-workings vignette).
  • Updated docs, examples and vignettes for the single migration flag, the new light_migration / light_switching defaults and the new default number of projection steps.
  • Examples now use named arguments (e.g. project(projection_object = obj), test_object_generator(object_name = ...)).
  • Dataset docs: Sex is described as numeric (1 = males, 2 = females) and data_population as 201 rows.
  • Corrected the flat_fertility description, the outmigration_rates column description, the Projection_object class description and the region field descriptions (with examples).
  • Updated the package description (CASPAR, Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project) and spelled “Pew” consistently.
  • Visualising-projections vignette: swapped emigration/immigration figures fixed, retention-by-sex figure added, and figures regenerated.
  • README: the introduction now matches the package description, and the examples were rewritten to show a full projection (step by step and with base_object_generator()), exporting results, and a quick run with test_object_generator().

measuringreligiouschange 1.0.1 (2026-11-09)

BUG FIXES

  • Enabled combined fertility factorization by default
  • Changed data used in testing to match Pew report
  • Fixed issue causing age group 0 to have incorrect mortality saved
  • Fixed save_csv_all argument ordering

measuringreligiouschange 1.0.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
